decision_rule.contradiction: A declared relation and its implementation disagree; this blocks that equation family.
decision_rule.conditional_compatibility: A lane passes only under explicit ontology, units, limit, residual, and evidence boundaries.
decision_rule.not_established: Missing proof is not labelled false, but it cannot support a physical claim.
decision_rule.special_case: A standard theory is a special case only when the same variables/units and a verified limit are shown.

coverage.coverage_boundary: The inventory is broad but not code-complete; code-only equations and full observable maps remain open.

family_matrix.reason: The canonical potential/derivative, information operator/source, and normalized beta semantics are conditionally closed in legacy_variational_v1; legacy_local remains a quarantined comparator.
Functional derivatives, conservation, ledger, and trace isolation pass in the normalized checks, but the full default causal gate fails.
The trace is derived from the dissipation history and does not feed back in the new mode; direct dimensional observability and physical backreaction remain open.
The local covariant evaluator passes its declared null/ordered limit, but this is not the Einstein field-equation system or a global closed-limit derivation.
The covariant current lane is a constitutive Maxwell-Cattaneo/control interface; coefficient origin, Kubo matching, and dimensional observables remain open.
The hyperbolic phase-field path is a fixed-form external comparator; it is not derived from the UET action.
The action-level Noether current is compatible in its parent lane, but the coarse-grained C mapping is many-to-one and does not prove the legacy C field or microscopic dissipation.
Lorentz transformation utilities and tests do not establish covariance of every physical operator or the legacy master dynamics.
The parameter registry still mixes normalized, natural-unit, and SI lanes globally; the scoped beta_normalized/Landauer separation is closed, but cross-family conversion remains open.
A complete measurement operator with units, uncertainty, resolution, and nuisance parameters is not closed for the core families.
Support and adapter code cannot create a physical claim without an owning equation family.
The finite-density O(2) EOS and ideal constitutive sector pass their natural-unit tree-level gates; transport provenance, SI, finite temperature, and universal C identity remain open.
The preregistered reduction from the O(2) EOS to the legacy symmetric double well fails its residual gate.
Projector, ideal current/stress, Josephson, Lorentz, entropy-sign, and causal-control checks pass, while missing coefficient provenance blocks physical dissipative promotion.
Explicit source and exchange terms can describe an effective subsystem; they do not prove that the whole universe is open or that a closed universe must reduce to Einstein GR.

principle_matrix.meaning: (C,Phi,Pi) are physical state variables and R/I_trace is derived history; no R feedback is allowed.

The canonical legacy_variational_v1 C/I functional, information operator/source, and normalized beta contracts pass their scoped checks; legacy_local behavior is preserved as a non-variational comparator.
C may map to density, Noether charge, or order parameter only inside a declared lane with units and observables.
Open-system accounting is valid for an explicitly bounded effective subsystem; global cosmic openness is not established.
GR and O(2) have narrow verified limits, but the O(2)-to-legacy-double-well reduction is rejected and no universal nesting theorem exists.
The new normalized candidate has internal ledger checks; the legacy A1 energy-conservation label and SI energy meaning are not established.
The strict-CFL frozen-C reference has compact support, but the default coupled candidate still fails pre-arrival leakage.
A complete measurement operator, units, uncertainty, provenance, and holdout chain is not closed for the core theory.

claim_boundary: The current repository evidence conditionally closes the normalized C/I operator and beta contract inside legacy_variational_v1, keeps legacy_local as a quarantined comparator, and retains unresolved standard-physics, causal, observable, and cross-family correspondence gates. It does not establish that all old theories are special cases of one UET equation, nor that UET is physically complete.
